[{"insert":"Press Core Conditioning
 
This piece pairs a pressing movement with hanging core work and adds burpees at the end of every round. The ladder drops to its smallest round in the middle at twelve, eight, four, then climbs back out, so the hardest rounds sit at both ends. Pick a bench weight you could hit for fifteen reps at RPE 8 to 9, because it has to survive all five rounds. Hold a steady pace rather than sprinting the opening round, and there is a fifteen minute cap.
"}]
